game_concept: A tower defense set in Coastal Port – Fish Market, a fish market full of crates: the sailor must hold off pirate raiders while practicing conditionals (if / elif / else). Core idea – Elif Ladder: Rank threats with an if/elif/else ladder and send the right response to each.
theme: Coastal Port – Fish Market: a fish market full of crates
core_gameplay_loop: In Fish Market, repeat each round: Rank threats with an if/elif/else ladder and send the right response to each. Then check threat_level and advance.
player_objective: Protect the ship's hull from pirate raiders in Fish Market: keep threat_level above zero until the 50-second timer ends.
controls: Keyboard: SPACE applies the code fix; H shows a hint; mouse/touch: tap the code panel to choose a value.
learning_alignment: Week 3 – Conditionals (if / elif / else) | Level 3 (intro tier): Elif Ladder
assets_style: pixel-art harbor town: deep blue sea, wooden docks, orange-roofed buildings, sailing ships; flat Kenney-style sprites; sea-shanty accordion with wave and gull ambience
duplicate_check_notes: Generic fallback template for Week 3, Level 3, Need Assistance. Deliberately a simple survival game; it is not one of the 2,700 unique pool games and is only used when no pool game can be served.
